key: A cricket coach at a district academy watches
name: ch22_coach_praise_then_no_ball
alt: At a district cricket academy net, a coach first praises a young fast bowler's out-swinger, then points to his front foot landing over the crease line.
scene: A wide view of an outdoor cricket net at a small-town district academy on a bright late afternoon, green practice pitch, netting on poles, a set of stumps at the far end. LEFT: a young fast bowler of about sixteen in white practice kit and a teal cap stands at the top of his run-up holding a red ball, chest out and smiling, clearly glowing from a compliment. RIGHT of him: the coach, a stocky man in his 50s in a navy track jacket with a whistle on a cord and a clipboard under one arm, one hand raised warmly towards the boy. Two inset bubbles float above the coach, numbered in order. Bubble 1 on the left shows the path of a ball as a curved dotted line swinging away past a bat, with a small gold star on it. Bubble 2 on the right shows a close-up of a bowling shoe landing past a white crease line, with a small coral mark where the foot crosses the line. A thin arrow runs from bubble 1 to bubble 2 to show the order: praise first, then the fix. In the foreground the white crease line is painted across the pitch, and the boy's next step is heading straight towards it. Mood: encouraging, warm sun, eager. Labels: "PRAISE FIRST" above bubble 1, "THEN THE FIX" above bubble 2.

key: Your uncle has written a long, flowery welcome speech
name: ch22_chacha_speech_trim
alt: Split picture: an uncle holds a speech so long it trails to the floor while hungry guests wait; next day he reads a short card and the wedding reception guests laugh.
scene: A split-panel picture divided by a thin vertical line, the same uncle in both halves: a cheerful man in his 60s with spectacles, grey moustache and a cream kurta with a maroon shawl. LEFT panel: in a living room he proudly holds up a speech written on a sheet so long it unrolls down to the floor and curls across the carpet. His young nephew (late 20s, blue shirt) sits beside him, leaning in and pointing to one highlighted amber section near the top of the sheet, smiling kindly; a small heart floats next to that section to show the honest praise. A wall clock above them shows a long sweep of twenty minutes shaded in coral. RIGHT panel: at a wedding reception hall with a marigold garland draped along the top and round tables laid with steel plates, the uncle stands at a small mic stand holding only a short card. Three guests at the nearest table laugh with heads thrown back, and a server carrying a tray of food waits nearby, showing dinner is coming on time. A small clock in this panel has only a thin teal wedge shaded. Mood: affectionate, festive, light. Labels: "20 MIN" above the left panel, "5 MIN" above the right panel.

key: A school principal in a small town writes to a brilliant
name: ch22_principal_praise_letter
alt: A small-town school principal writes a letter to her new science head; the letter is shown large, opening with praise, then a warning, then a confident send-off.
scene: A calm office in a small-town Indian school, morning light through a window showing a two-storey cream school building with a flagpole. LEFT: the principal, a woman in her 50s in a teal cotton saree with spectacles and her hair in a bun, sits at a wooden desk with a pen in hand, looking thoughtful but firm; a cup of chai and a neat stack of files sit on the desk, and a small brass bell. RIGHT half: the letter she is writing is shown large, as if held up to the viewer, a white sheet with handwritten lines drawn as grey strokes, divided into three bands. The top band, longest, has a small green tick and a gold star beside it for the genuine praise. The middle band has a small amber exclamation badge beside it for the honest warning about past grumbling and the wish for a strong hand. The bottom band is short and underlined in teal, with a small arrow pointing forward, for the send-off to go and make the department the best. A dashed arrow curves from the small sheet on her desk up to the large letter, showing it is the same letter. Mood: serious, warm, trusting. Labels: "PRAISE" beside the top band, "WARNING" beside the middle band, "GO" beside the bottom band.

key: lift has been broken for three weeks and the repair
name: ch22_workshop_tea_lift
alt: A housing society secretary admires the neatly labelled parts cabinet in a contractor's small workshop over tea, and the owner promises to send his best man to fix the broken lift on Monday.
scene: A small industrial workshop in Peenya, Bengaluru, on a Saturday morning, concrete floor, a workbench with a vice, and a tall steel cabinet of small drawers, each drawer carrying a neat white label. CENTRE: the workshop owner, a man in his 40s in a grey work shirt with sleeves rolled up and a pencil behind his ear, beams with pride as he opens one drawer of the cabinet he designed to show it off. Beside him the housing society secretary, a retired man in his 60s in a light checked shirt and spectacles, leans in admiring, one hand raised in appreciation. Between them on a stool sit two small steaming glasses of tea. LEFT inset bubble: the broken apartment lift with closed steel doors, a red cross on its button panel and a small hourglass to show the three weeks of waiting. RIGHT inset bubble: a wall calendar page with a teal circle on Monday and a young technician in blue overalls carrying a toolbox towards the lift, with a green tick on the lift doors. A dashed arrow runs from the owner's smile to the Monday bubble, showing the goodwill caused the promise. Mood: friendly, relieved, warm morning light. Labels: "3 WEEKS" above the left bubble, "MONDAY" above the right bubble.

key: A new waiter at a busy Udupi restaurant in Chennai
name: ch22_udupi_waiter_tally
alt: After closing at a Chennai Udupi restaurant, the owner sits with a young waiter, praises how customers ask for him, and shows him a shortcut for tallying his bills.
scene: Inside a South Indian vegetarian restaurant after closing time, chairs stacked on some tables, steel tumblers and davara cups on a shelf, a single ceiling fan, warm light over the cash counter. CENTRE foreground: at a marble-topped table the owner, a man in his 50s in a white shirt and veshti with sandalwood mark on his forehead, sits beside a young waiter of about nineteen in a cream uniform shirt; the owner points at a small pad of bills and a stack of paper slips while the boy leans in, attentive and relieved. A small calculator sits between them. Above the boy, a thought bubble shows a smiling regular customer holding a filter coffee tumbler with a small heart, standing for the praise that customers ask for him by name. RIGHT background: the senior waiter, a thin older man with folded arms and a sceptical frown, watches from behind the cash counter. LEFT: a small inset shows a stopwatch with the hand far round in coral, then an arrow to a second stopwatch with only a small teal wedge, showing that within a week he closes fastest. Mood: kind, patient, late evening. Labels: "BEFORE" under the first stopwatch, "ONE WEEK" under the second stopwatch.

key: A good physiotherapist in a Kochi clinic
name: ch22_physio_shoulder_trust
alt: In a Kochi physiotherapy clinic a physiotherapist praises a patient's improved shoulder movement, then presses the painful spot while the patient breathes through it trusting her.
scene: A bright, clean physiotherapy clinic in Kochi, a window showing coconut palms, a wall chart of the human skeleton, and a rack of resistance bands and small dumbbells. CENTRE: a patient, a man in his 40s in a plain grey T-shirt, sits sideways on a padded treatment table. The physiotherapist, a woman in her 30s in a white coat over a teal salwar with her hair tied back, stands behind him, one hand on his upper arm and her thumb pressing firmly on a spot over his shoulder blade, marked by a small coral burst to show the pain. He winces slightly with eyes closed but breathes out slowly, shown by curved breath lines from his mouth. LEFT inset bubble from the physiotherapist: two arcs drawn from a shoulder, a short grey arc for last week and a longer teal arc for today, with a small gold star, showing the honest praise about his range of movement. RIGHT side: a tall simple gauge with its needle high in the teal zone, showing that his trust keeps him calm through the pain; below it a small calendar page with next week circled, showing he comes back. Mood: calm, reassuring, soft daylight. Labels: "TRUST" above the gauge.
